news.headline: A Third Way to Read a Margin: What XEOS's AURA 10 Means for the Perimeter Thesis
news.summary: An independent investor analysis examined XEOS's AURA 10 specimen PET-CT imager, whose large multicenter BrIMA study was published in JAMA Surgery, as a third distinct approach to intraoperative margin assessment alongside Perimeter's Claire OCT+AI and Dilon's MarginProbe 2. The piece assessed what the molecular-imaging alternative means for Perimeter's competitive positioning and investment thesis.

news.headline: AI in Healthcare: Perimeter CEO on Clinical AI
news.summary: A profile/interview with Perimeter CEO Adrian Mendes covered how his prior experience scaling AI-hardware company Groq informs his approach to developing and commercializing Claire's clinical AI for breast-conserving surgery. Date is approximate (published in the first days of August 2026).

news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Initiates Coverage with Buy Rating, C$1.54 Price Target
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets started coverage of Perimeter (TSXV:PINK; OTCQX:PYNKF) with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (US$1.11) price target, versus a C$0.32 close on July 13. The target is based on a 10-year DCF assuming sharp 2026 uptake of Claire OCT followed by steady growth toward 9%+ lumpectomy penetration by 2035.

news.headline: Claire vs. the Competition: How Perimeter's Device Stacks Up Against a New Rival and the Old Standby
news.summary: An independent investor analysis compared Perimeter's newly FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI to Dilon Technologies' MarginProbe 2, a rival real-time margin-assessment device that received FDA clearance in December 2025 and posted 76.8% sensitivity in its U.S. pivotal trial, as well as to routine cavity shaving. The piece framed the competitive stakes for reducing breast-cancer lumpectomy reoperation rates as Claire begins its U.S. commercial rollout.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter a New Healthcare Top Pick
news.summary: Paradigm Capital named Perimeter a new Top Pick with a speculative buy rating and C$0.95 price target, versus a C$0.275 close on July 3. The analyst cited the March 2026 FDA PMA approval of Claire as positioning the company to accelerate commercial rollout and draw more market interest.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 financial results & earnings call
catalysts.detail: Perimeter has not yet issued an official press release confirming the date of its Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30) earnings call. This will be a key near-term readout for commercial-rollout metrics (Claire placements, sales funnel, revenue) and could include further disclosure on VA (Veterans Affairs) revenue. Note: a July 23-24, 2026 GlobeNewswire release titled 'Perimeter Announces Date for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call' refers to the unrelated NYSE-listed Perimeter Solutions (PRM), not this company, and has been excluded here.

catalysts.when: CMS decision expected effective Jan 1, 2027 (Oct 1, 2026 possible but unlikely)
catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC / MEARIS reimbursement decision
catalysts.detail: Perimeter is pursuing Medicare reimbursement for Claire via CMS's New Technology APC pathway under the MEARIS quarterly filing process, aided by Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device designation. A June 2026 MEARIS filing points to a most-likely effective date of January 1, 2027 for a new HCPCS code, with first Medicare/Medicare Advantage claims expected in Q1 2027; no official CMS decision has been confirmed yet.

catalysts.label: Continued commercial rollout of Claire OCT+AI amid a widening competitive field
catalysts.detail: Following March 2026 FDA PMA approval, Perimeter is scaling commercial placements of Claire across existing hospital relationships (e.g., Intermountain Health, Medical City Dallas) and pursuing new health-system agreements. The competitive field has broadened beyond FDA-cleared rival Dilon Technologies' MarginProbe 2 to include XEOS's AURA 10 specimen PET-CT imager, backed by a newly published multicenter BrIMA study; incremental placement/adoption announcements and competitive differentiation remain a recurring near-term catalyst.

pulse: Perimeter continues commercializing its FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI device for intraoperative breast-cancer margin assessment, with the competitive landscape broadening as independent analysts now weigh a third rival approach (XEOS's AURA 10 specimen PET-CT) alongside Dilon's MarginProbe 2, even as sell-side sentiment stays bullish following Paradigm Capital (Top Pick, C$0.95 target) and Brookline Capital Markets (Buy, C$1.54 target) initiations in early-to-mid July 2026. The stock traded around US$0.21 (C$0.28-0.32) as of early-to-mid August 2026. The company has not yet officially confirmed a date for its Q2 2026 earnings call (third-party trackers estimate early September); a widely-indexed July 24 GlobeNewswire item of that name actually refers to the unrelated NYSE company Perimeter Solutions and was excluded from this file. The pending CMS New Technology APC/MEARIS reimbursement decision, likely effective January 2027, remains the other key catalyst to watch.
